responsibility: Implements a debugging dumper for Rust HIR trees using the HIRFullVisitor interface. It walks an HIR crate and emits a textual, indented representation of the crate, selected item and expression nodes, attributes, and mappings to an output stream, with many visit hooks present as stubs for future expansion. Its role is inspection and diagnostics of constructed HIR, not transformation or semantic analysis.
same_name_distinction: Implements the HIR dumper's output behavior—its go routine and visitor method bodies for rendering selected HIR nodes—whereas rust-hir-dump.h only declares the Dump visitor interface and stored state.
